patterns_found.issue_1: Root allomorphs: Some roots appear in full form (capax, stare, abstrahere) which nominalize to longer forms (capacitas, statio, abstractio). Family structure must show full nominalized root.
patterns_found.issue_2: Suffix identity: -tion and -ation are variants of same morpheme. Verification needed for consistent representation.
patterns_found.issue_3: Prefix handling: Some words have clear prefixes (ab-) that must be separated correctly from roots.
